name: Imperial College London
officialName: Imperial College of Science, Technology and Medicine
summary: Imperial College London is a public university in London focused on science, engineering, medicine and business, chartered in 1907. UK undergraduate applications are made through UCAS.

internationalShare.notes: Sources retrieved gave conflicting or non-comparable figures; use the Imperial statistics guide.

studentFacultyRatio.notes: Imperial publishes ratios by faculty only (e.g. Business School 24.4:1), no university-wide figure retrieved.

english.minOverall: 6.5 (Standard level) or 7.0 (Higher level), depending on course

internationalTuition.notes: Range across the 2026-27 overseas fees retrieved: Imperial Business School 42,700 and Department of Computing 45,500. Fees vary by course.

domesticTuition.notes: Home fee shown on the 2027-entry course page.

scholarships.name: Imperial Inspires scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: International applicants paying the Overseas rate of tuition and applying for a full-time undergraduate course (or selected PGT) in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Medicine or Imperial Business School for 2027 entry.
scholarships.coverage: At least GBP 15,000 per year for the full duration of the course; at least 300 scholarships for 2027 entry

scholarships.name: Imperial Excellence Scholarship (BSc Economics, Finance and Data Science)
scholarships.eligibility: Recognises outstanding candidates joining the programme for academic achievement, leadership potential and commitment to the Business School community.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration deadline (all courses except MBBS Medicine)

opportunities.name: Imperial Enterprise Lab
opportunities.description: Student-focused innovation and entrepreneurship programmes, including the seven-week Venture Catalyst Challenge with a GBP 80,000 prize fund.

opportunities.name: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Programme (UROP)
opportunities.description: Paid research placements, mainly 6-10 weeks over the summer, with around 450+ opportunities each year.

opportunities.name: Careers support for BSc Economics, Finance and Data Science
opportunities.description: One-to-one guidance for spring weeks, internships and graduate roles in finance, consulting, technology and the public sector.

programs.name: Computing (BEng)
programs.school: Department of Computing, Faculty of Engineering
programs.summary: Imperial's Department of Computing BEng built on discrete mathematics, logic and programming, with small-group tutorials in year 1. Applicants must sit the TMUA.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering MEng
programs.summary: Four-year course: solid mechanics, thermofluids and mechatronics, with hands-on workshop sessions.

programs.name: Chemistry BSc
programs.summary: Inorganic, organic, physical, analytical, synthetic and computational chemistry with an extensive lab programme.

programs.name: Physics BSc
programs.summary: Mechanics, relativity and quantum physics through modules, lab work and projects.

programs.name: Mathematics BSc
programs.summary: Algebra, analysis, probability and statistics, with over 50 specialised modules.

programs.name: Biological Sciences BSc
programs.summary: Living systems from molecules to ecosystems, ending with an extensive research project.

programs.name: Medicine MBBS/BSc
programs.summary: Six-year integrated course awarding both an MBBS and a BSc.

housing.value: First-years who make Imperial their firm choice are guaranteed a place in College halls if they apply by the deadline (17 July 2026 for 2026 entry). Rent includes bills, internet and basic contents insurance.

admissionStats.notes: Imperial reports an applications-to-admissions ratio of 10.1:1 overall (Computing 19.6:1, Business School 28.3:1, Engineering 9.4:1, Medicine 10:1). Admissions count entrants, not offers.
